human_summary: Present owner-facing product decisions with options, tradeoffs, risks, and required owner action.

options.label: Narrow MVP
options.description: Deliver the smallest coherent workflow first.

options.label: Broader MVP
options.description: Include more workflow coverage in the initial plan.

decision_cards.risk: Unclear scope can produce invalid downstream task packets.
decision_cards.required_owner_action: Select one option or provide revised scope.
